desc:
Defeat your opponents in the ultimate swim battle! Swim higher, attack rivals, use boosters, and conserve your air to stay in the game. The crown goes to the last player who does not drown.

🏊‍♂️ Swim Up: Try to swim as high as possible so that the energy decreases slowly.
💰 Earn Cash: Watch your cash balance grow as you stay alive longer and buy special abilities.
🎯 Sabotage Rivals: Use fun and creative tools to make other players drown!
⚡️ Boost Your Air: Grab air bubbles, air tanks, and other power-ups to keep yourself in the game.
👑 Be the Last Underwater: Outsmart, outlast, and outplay your opponents to become the ultimate champion of swim!
